messages:
Maya (marketing): Morning — saw a batch of inbound leads miss the 60s claim SLA. Looks like enrichment timeouts then RR slots recycled.
Liam (revops): Is this HubSpot or Salesforce? any source filters?
Maya (marketing): HubSpot, mainly 'product_trial' and 'webinar_signup', spike ~06:50 UTC. Enricher reports vendor latency ~30-40s.
Priya (ops): If enrichment blocks assignment we should accept then assign provisional owner immediately, and PATCH when enrichment returns. Avoids waiting synchronously.
Noah (sales-eng): Agree. Mitigation: 1) shorten HS wait to 8s, 2) set property provisional_owner at ingest, 3) enricher sends async PATCH /lead/:id/enrichment.
Liam (revops): Also change RR pool: ttl 18->40s, eviction LIFO->LRU, size 2->4 to reduce churn.
Maya (marketing): Let's canary 3% APAC for 12h and track claim_p50/p95, owner_flip_rate, SLA_misses. I'll update the handoff playbook wording.
Priya (ops): I'll open INF ticket to add PATCH endpoint (202 + Location). ETA 4h.
Noah (sales-eng): Backfill unassigned leads last 2h with provisional_owner after cutover. Liam to own.
Liam (revops): Will run backfill post-canary. Setting alert: SLA_misses > 2% for 30m -> rollback.
Maya (marketing): Perfect. I'll post canary comms and short note for sales explaining provisional owner semantics. :thumbsup:
